Overture release: 2026-10-21.0. The release date is not an imagery-capture date.
Original footprint changes: clipped bounds, simplified and rounded coordinates, spatial tiles, explicit display-height properties.

This height attribution supplements, and does not replace, the original footprint attribution and ODbL distribution terms above.

Current height categories for 49,378 retained footprints:
- heightSource=tag: 346 source-provided heights, not independently verified.
- heightSource=levels: 17 source floor counts times an estimated 3 metres.
- heightSource=globfp2020: 41,855 remote-sensing height predictions from 3D-GloBFP (2020), assigned after strict footprint matching.
- heightSource=default: 7,160 fixed 12 metre display heights, neither measured nor predicted.
- heightSource=measured: 0; no independently surveyed heights were introduced.

Before V56, 49,015 buildings used the 12 metre default. The height supplement changes only heightMeters and heightSource of eligible default-height features. Original IDs, footprint geometry, all other properties and the existing tag/levels heights are retained.

Association rules: IoU >= 0.60; target and source coverage >= 0.75; every target MultiPolygon part coverage >= 0.75. Reject a second source with target coverage >= 0.20. One source is assigned to at most one updated target. Accept only finite source heights in [2, 1000] metres, rounded to 0.1 metre for display. Rounding is not a precision or accuracy claim. Ambiguous and unmatched targets retain their original default.

The 138 building tiles total 17,272,449 bytes. Individual-tile gzip estimates total 3,256,654 bytes; the largest tile is 292,649 bytes. Actual transfer size depends on hosting compression.

The 2020 predictions and later footprint release have different reference dates. Spatial overlap does not validate local height accuracy. These are flat-roof LoD1 display volumes, not current surveyed buildings, measured roof geometry or photogrammetry. No random footprints or random heights were generated.

See ../buildings-source.json for bounds, counts, original sources, download URLs and checksums.
See ../building-height-source.json for height provenance, acceptance/rejection counts and limitations, and ../building-height-associations.json.gz for the per-building association ledger and original prediction values.
